batches.target_focus: Data Principal rights (ss. 11-14), Data Fiduciary obligations (ss. 4-10), Significant Data Fiduciaries (s. 10), and penalties under Schedule
batches.evidence_requirements: Exact verbatim passage from indexed DPDP chunks; section and subsection references; explicit mention of Section 1(2) phased commencement
batches.validation_rules: Strict verbatim substring check against source text; check that penalty amounts match Schedule exactly (e.g. up to 250 crore rupees)
batches.legal_review_requirements: Advocate must verify whether cited rule-making provisions (ss. 40-42) rely on notified rules

batches.target_focus: Civil penalties (ss. 43, 44), criminal cyber offences (ss. 65, 66, 66C, 66D, 67, 67A), and intermediary safe harbour (s. 79)
batches.evidence_requirements: Exact verbatim passage from IT Act 2000; correct compound subsections (e.g. s.66E privacy violation, s.67B child sexual abuse material)
batches.validation_rules: Verify that s.66A is noted as struck down by Supreme Court in Shreya Singhal (2015); verify that s.43A is noted as pending omission under DPDP s.44(2)
batches.legal_review_requirements: Advocate must certify that no unconstitutional or repealed provisions are presented as active law

batches.target_focus: Admissibility of electronic messages, emails, server logs, and hash algorithms across BSA ss. 61-63 and IT Act definitions
batches.evidence_requirements: Dual-source citation: BSA Section 61 Explanation and IT Act Section 2(1)(t) / Section 2(1)(r)
batches.validation_rules: Multi-source citation validator: both source IDs must exist in supporting_source_ids and both must have verified passages
batches.legal_review_requirements: Advocate review of certificate compliance under Section 63(4) BSA vs former Section 65B(4) Evidence Act

batches.target_focus: Three-fold proportionality test (legitimate aim, suitability/rational nexus, necessity/least restrictive means, balance/proportionality stricto sensu)
batches.evidence_requirements: Exact verbatim extracts from Paras 1-6 and Ratio Decidendi of Puttaswamy judgment
batches.validation_rules: Negative constraint check: must not assert that privacy is an absolute or unregulated right; must reflect that it is subject to reasonable restrictions under Art 21
batches.legal_review_requirements: Constitutional law advocate must verify proportionality formulation against Chandrachud J. and Kaul J. separate opinions

batches.target_focus: Mandatory Section 63(4) Certificate drafting templates for electronic evidence produced from laptops, mobile devices, CCTV servers, and cloud databases
batches.evidence_requirements: Verbatim reflection of all conditions in Section 63(2) and signatory categories under Section 63(4)(a)-(c)
batches.validation_rules: Title validation: must strictly be titled 'Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023' (zero tolerance for previously observed hallucinated title); must include standard jurat and affidavit clauses
batches.legal_review_requirements: Trial advocate review for admissibility before Sessions Court and High Court criminal benches

batches.target_focus: Safe refusal and out-of-corpus queries across Civil Procedure (CPC Order 7 R 11), Limitation Act, Arbitration Act, Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code (IBC s.7/9), and Indian Contract Act
batches.evidence_requirements: Explicit refusal declaration indicating that the topic is outside the verified LegalMitra Knowledge Base
batches.validation_rules: Negative constraint: zero hallucinated sections, zero fabricated deadlines, output must contain phrase 'insufficient evidence in corpus'
batches.legal_review_requirements: Verify that refusal reasons are legally sound and do not accidentally disclaim indexed law
